d: You will love this Best Konnakol with ghatam exponent Giridhar Udupa who is a percussionist par excellence from India. This video is from the concert titled ‘Percussion Masters’ - a percussion ensemble consisting of the Tabla, Jori, Mridangam and Ghatam. This Konnakol solo recital of the young Ghatam player will definitely give you a boost. You can feel the energy in this presentation which is loved by all of the musicians on the stage and in the audience. This is one of our favourite Konnakol solo recitals.
